pairs.evidence: scripts/visual-gen/pof_mesh_critique.py:67 When the degenerate-face measurement throws, the deterministic Tier-1 critic emits a clean reading of 0 instead of an ungraded or error marker, so a failed measurement reaches the scorer as 'no defect'.

techniques.evidence: scripts/visual-gen/pof_mesh_critique.py:67 The gate is otherwise deterministic and emits a measurement per key (pof_loop_closure.py fails closed with POF_LOOP_ERROR markers). This fallback, though, turns a failed measurement into a passing number rather than failing closed.

pairs.subject: generative-artifact-gating
pairs.evidence: src/lib/visual-gen/input-gate.ts:173 When the Tier-0 input gate cannot run, the paid image-to-3D generation still proceeds ungated (inputGateRefusal returns null unless the gate actually ran and returned 'fail'), which is the technique's named failure of waving an artifact through instead of stopping the spend.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/visual-gen/input-gate.ts:173 There is a gate on the input before the paid stage (inputGateRefusal refuses on fail), but an unavailable gate lets the spend go ahead instead of reporting a precondition failure and stopping.

src/lib/visual-gen/input-gate.ts:105 A VLM score alone can produce 'pass' (accept). Cropping, which a deterministic raw-margin measurement would catch, is left to the model, and line 83 admits it is that grader's blind spot. view-critique.ts:224 likewise returns pass from a model.
src/lib/visual-gen/view-critique.ts:196 The view gate's reason cites the rendered view file that drove the verdict rather than paraphrasing it.
src/lib/visual-gen/best-of-n.ts:244 Each roll's actual delivered mesh is critiqued before acceptance; a roll that produced no mesh is never accepted.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/blender-mcp/service.ts:532 Downloads and generation imports share one result shape (ImportedObject = objectName only), and no acquisition record carrying the licence exists.

src/lib/blender-mcp/service.ts:475 Paid Rodin/Hunyuan jobs are dispatched with no reservation, cap or stop latch. The route's ledger (src/app/api/blender-mcp/generate/route.ts:30) records only AFTER the provider accepts and bills the job.
src/lib/blender-mcp/mcp-gate.ts:117 mcp-gate fetches the delivered mesh and grades that file. With no resultUrl or a failed fetch it reports delivered-ungated with a reason, never a pass.
